response.justification: Bogdan brings 10+ years of full-stack engineering experience well beyond the 6-year requirement, with directly relevant recent work in TypeScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB and AWS at Optilyz, plus current AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling work that maps precisely to the 'AI agent development' requirement. He is polyglot (TypeScript, Java, C/C++, Swift, D, PHP), has a CS bachelor's degree, strong testing/TDD credentials (built his own D test runner and assertion library, taught Selenium and TDD courses), and Docker/Kubernetes exposure. Gaps are mostly framework-specific rather than fundamental: no explicit Nest.js, Vitest/Jest, PostgreSQL, or Kotlin experience, and frontend depth leans toward Ember rather than React. Given the demonstrated ability to pick up new stacks and the architecture/craftsmanship focus, these are low-risk gaps worth probing in an interview.
strengths: 10+ years full-stack across TypeScript/Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS
Hands-on AI-agent and MCP tooling experience — a rare, explicitly required skill
Deep testing/TDD credibility: built test frameworks, taught TDD and Selenium courses
concerns: No stated Nest.js, Vitest/Jest, or Playwright experience
Frontend depth skews Ember/legacy; React exposure appears limited to one role
Kotlin absent and Java/PostgreSQL experience is dated or unmentioned

key_factors.factor: Relevant full-stack TS/Node depth and tenure
Gaps in core stack specifics (Nest.js, Vitest, React depth, Kotlin)
